English Wizard.question: ১) Avenge is -
English Wizard.option1: ক) to take vengeance for
English Wizard.option2: খ) to make sour or bitter.
English Wizard.option3: গ) to be a member of the middle class.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) to serve as a reminder of.
English Wizard.exp:
• Avenge is to take vengeance for. 
According to Cambridge Dictionary: to do harm to or punish the person responsible for something bad done to you or your family or friends in order to achieve a fair situation:

• Acerbate is to make sour or bitter.
• Bourgeois is to be a member of the middle class. 
• Commemorate is to serve as a reminder of.

English Wizard.question: ২) The words that same in spelling and sound, but different in meaning is called -
English Wizard.option1: ক) Homophone
English Wizard.option2: খ) Homonym
English Wizard.option3: গ) Homograph
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Synonym
English Wizard.exp:
• Homonym:
A word that sounds the same or/and is spelled the same as another word but has a different meaning. 
Example: "Write” and “right” are example of Homonym.
 
• Homophone:
A word that is pronounced the same as another word but has a different meaning or spelling, or both.
Example: to/two/too are example of Homophone.
 
• Homograph:
A word that is spelled the same as another word but has a different meaning.
Example: sow meaning "female pig," and sow, "to plant seeds”.
 
• Synonym:
A word or phrase that has the same or nearly the same meaning as another word or phrase in the same language.
Example: "small" and "little" are synonyms.

English Wizard.question: ৩) The word ‘Laconic’ means:
English Wizard.option1: ক) Using few words to express what you mean.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Foods made from milk.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Lack of something
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) an area of shallow water
English Wizard.exp:
Laconic
- Using very few words to express what you mean
- অল্পকথায় প্রকাশিত: a laconic person স্বল্পভাষী ব্যক্তি।

English Wizard.question: ৪) Graphology is the study of -
English Wizard.option1: ক) earth and rocks
English Wizard.option2: খ) relation between organism and environment
English Wizard.option3: গ) weather
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) hand writing to analyse character of the writer
English Wizard.exp:
• Graphology - Study of hand writing to analyse character of the writer 
• Geology - Study of earth and rocks
• Ecology - Study of relation between organism and environment
• Meteorology - Study of weather

English Wizard.question: ৫) An expert in writing by hand -
English Wizard.option1: ক) Lexicographer
English Wizard.option2: খ) Cacographer
English Wizard.option3: গ) Chirographer
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Cartographer
English Wizard.exp:
• Cacography - Illegible or bad handwriting.
• Cartographer - An expert in drawing maps.
• Chirographer - An expert in writing by hand.
• Lexicographer - A person whose job is to write dictionaries.

English Wizard.question: ৬) ‘Horde’ refers to -
English Wizard.option1: ক) A large group of people
English Wizard.option2: খ) A supply that is carefully guarded.
English Wizard.option3: গ) A storehouse for grain.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Food for cattle or horses.
English Wizard.exp:
• Hoard is a supply that is carefully guarded or hidden. 
• Horde is a large group, esp. of people.
• Granary is a storehouse for grain.
• Forage is food for cattle or horses.

English Wizard.question: ৭) The time before night when it is not yet dark-
English Wizard.option1: ক) Evening
English Wizard.option2: খ) Dawn
English Wizard.option3: গ) Dusk
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Eclipse
English Wizard.exp:
• Dusk:
- the time before night when it is not yet dark.
- সন্ধ্যার প্রাক্কাল; গোধূলি; আংশিক অন্ধকার রঙের কালচে ভাব।
 
• Evening (সন্ধ্যাকাল)
- the part of the day between the afternoon and the time you go to bed

• Dawn (ঊষা; ভোর)
- the time of day when light first appears

• Eclipse (গ্রহণ)
- an occasion when the moon passes between the earth and the sun so that you cannot see all or part of the sun for a time;
- an occasion when the earth passes between the moon and the sun so that you cannot see all or part of the moon for a time
 
Source: Oxford Dictionary

English Wizard.question: ৮) We use “i.e.” in a sentence to mean -
English Wizard.option1: ক) Approximately
English Wizard.option2: খ) For example
English Wizard.option3: গ) That is
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Notice it
English Wizard.exp:
i.e.
 - id est (= Latin for "that is")
- Used especially in writing before a piece of information that makes the meaning of something clearer or shows its true meaning.
 
e.g.
- Exempli gratia: 
- A Latin phrase that means "for example". It can be pronounced as "e.g." or "for example":
 
NB (from Latin ‘nota bene’)
- used in writing to make somebody take notice of a particular piece of information that is important.

English Wizard.question: ৯) “property, business, and industry are controlled by private owners rather than by the state” - this is the main theme of –
English Wizard.option1: ক) Marxism
English Wizard.option2: খ) Capitalism
English Wizard.option3: গ) Socialism
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Structuralism
English Wizard.exp:
• Capitalism
- An economic and political system in which property, business, and industry are controlled by private owners rather than by the state, with the purpose of making a profit.
- An economic system based on private ownership of property and business, with the goal of making the greatest possible profits for the owners.
 
• Marxism
A social, political, and economic theory based on the ideas of Karl Marx, who imagined a society where the methods of production would be owned and controlled by all its members.
 
• Socialism
The set of beliefs that states that all people are equal and should share equally in a country's money, or the political systems based on these beliefs.
 
• Structuralism 
A way of studying human culture, for example language, literature, art, or anthropology, that emphasizes the importance of its basic structures and the relationships between its parts

English Wizard.question: ১০) What is the correct indirect form of: I said to him, “You had better speak the truth”.
English Wizard.option1: ক) He proposed to speaking the truth.
English Wizard.option2: খ) I advised that he had better spoken the truth.
English Wizard.option3: গ) I suggested that he had spoken the truth better.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) I advised him to speak the truth.
English Wizard.exp:
You had better speak the truth. = তুমি বরং সত্যটা বললেই ভালো হবে।
এর দ্বারা মূলত উপদেশই বুঝাচ্ছে।
তাই Reporting Verb হিসেবে Advised বসবে এবং এর পর নিয়ম অনুযায়ী to + Verb বসবে।

English Wizard.question: ১১) Which one is in the correct indirect narration: ''Why have you beaten the boy?'' he said to me.
English Wizard.option1: ক) He demanded me why had I beaten the boy.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He asked me why I have beaten the boy.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He inquired me why I had beaten the boy.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He enquired of me why I had beaten the boy.
English Wizard.exp:
নিয়ম অনুযায়ী Present Perfect = Past Perfect হবে।
বাক্যটিকে Assertive এ রূপান্তরিত করতে হবে এবং এ হিসেবে Auxiliary Verb - Subject এর পরে বসবে।

Inquired/ enquired এর পর Object এর পূর্বে of বসে।
সে অনুযায়ী, সঠিক indirect form: He enquired of me why I had beaten the boy.

English Wizard.question: ১২) Choose the correct indirect speech: Jamal asked me, 'Are you happy in your current job?'
English Wizard.option1: ক) Jamal asked me if I was happy in my current job.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Jamal asked me if I have been happy in my current job.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Jamal asked me whether I am happy in my current job.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Jamal asked me if I had been happy in my current job.
English Wizard.exp:
Yes/No Question (প্রশ্নের উত্তর হ্যাঁ বা না) হলে Reported Speech এর আগে if হয়।
Reported Speech কে Indirect করার সময় সর্বদা Assertive Sentence এ লিখতে হয়।
আর Reporting Verb- Past Tense হলে Reported Speech কে নিয়ম অনুযায়ী পরিবর্তন করতে হয়। 

নিয়ম হচ্ছে -
চার প্রকারের Present হবে চার প্রকারের Past.
Past Indefinite হবে Past Perfect.

সে অনুসারে সঠিক indirect speech: Jamal asked me if I was happy in my current job.

English Wizard.question: ১৩) Kollol told me that Koli had not gone there the previous day. (Make it Direct)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Kollol said to me, “Koli has not gone there the previous day.”
English Wizard.option2: খ) Kollol said to me, “Koli did not go there yesterday.”
English Wizard.option3: গ) Kollol said to me, “Koli has not come here the previous day”.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Kollol said to me, “Koli has not gone there yesterday.”
English Wizard.exp:
Indirect Narration এ Past Perfect থাকলে তিনটি Tense হওয়ার সম্ভাবনা আছে (যা নির্ধারিত হবে Adverb of Time, Conjunction ইত্যাদির উপর ভিত্তি করে)।
যথা:
- Present Perfect 
- Past Indefinite 
- Past Perfect

যেহেতু এখানে the previous day উল্লেখ করা আছে, তাই এটা Past Indefinite Tense হওয়াই বাঞ্ছনীয়। আর the previous day এর পরিবর্তে yesterday ব্যবহৃত হবে। 
সে অনুসারে সঠিক direct form: Kollol said to me, “Koli did not go there yesterday.”

English Wizard.question: ১৪) He requested me to clarify the question I had asked. (Make it direct)
English Wizard.option1: ক) He said to me, “You will clarify the question asked”.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He said to me, “Please, clarify the question you have asked”.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He said to me, “You clarify the question”.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He said to me, “Will you clarify the question asked?”
English Wizard.exp:
Indirect Narration এ request থাকলে direct speech এ রূপান্তর করার সময় please যোগ হতে পারে এবং বাক্যটা Imperative হবে।
তাই সঠিক উত্তর: He said to me, “Please, clarify the question you have asked”.

English Wizard.question: ১৫) How interesting the game was! (Make it assertive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) It was an interesting game.
English Wizard.option2: খ) It was a very interesting game.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The game was very interesting.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The game was enough interesting.
English Wizard.exp:
এখানে Subject হচ্ছে the game.
How এর পরিবর্তে Assertive Sentence এ সাধারণত very ব্যবহৃত হয়। 
Enough বসালে বাক্যের ভাবার্থ ঠিক থাকবে না। তাছাড়া Adjective এর আগে enough বসে না, পরে বসে। Noun এর আগে enough বসতে পারে। 

তাই বাক্যটির সঠিক assertive form: The game was very interesting.

English Wizard.question: ১৬) They should respect their seniors. (Make it imperative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Respect their seniors.
English Wizard.option2: খ) They respect their seniors.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Let them respect their seniors.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Let’s respect their seniors.
English Wizard.exp:
You ছাড়া অন্য Subject থাকলে Imperative Sentence এর শুরুতে Let ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং Subject এর Objective Form বসে।

সে অনুসারে সঠিক imperative sentence: Let them respect their seniors.

English Wizard.question: ১৭) I conducted research on it.  (Make it interrogative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Do I conducted research on it?
English Wizard.option2: খ) Don’t I conducted research on it?
English Wizard.option3: গ) Did I conduct research on it?
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Didn’t I conduct research on it?
English Wizard.exp:
Assertive কে Interrogative এ Transform করতে হলে Negative Interrogative এ পরিণত করতে হয়।
এর পাশাপাশি বাক্যটি Past Indefinite Tense হওয়ায় Didn’t যোগ হবে।

English Wizard.question: ১৮) It is a matter of sorrow that you have lost your daughter. (Make it exclamatory)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Fie! You have lost your daughter.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Alas! You have lost your daughter.
English Wizard.option3: গ) How have you lost your daughter!
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Have you lost your daughter!
English Wizard.exp:
It is a matter of sorrow থাকলে এর পরিবর্তে Exclamatory Sentence এ ‘Alas!’ বসে।
সে অনুসারে সঠিক উত্তর খ)

English Wizard.question: ১৯) Never yield to corruption. (Make it Assertive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) You will never yield to corruption.
English Wizard.option2: খ) We should never yield to corruption.
English Wizard.option3: গ) You should never yield to corruption.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) You never should yield to corruption.
English Wizard.exp:
Imperative Sentence এ Subject – You হলে তা উহ্য থাকে।
you ছাড়া অন্য কিছু Subject হলে Let + Objective Form of Subject বসে।
তাই Subject বিহীন Imperative বাক্যের Subject হিসেবে You ধরে নিয়ে Assertive এ তা প্রকাশ্যভাবে লিখতে হবে। এর পর Should বসবে। তার পর Main Verb.

তাই সঠিক উত্তর (গ)। 
ঘ) ভুল, কারণ 'Never' Auxiliary Verb এর আগে বসে না।

English Wizard.question: ২০) Where can he find me? (Make it assertive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) He can never find me.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He can find me nowhere.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He cannot find me somewhere.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He cannot find me wherever.
English Wizard.exp:
Where যুক্ত Interrogative কে Assertive করতে হলে nowhere (কোথাও না) বসবে। 
Somewhere = কোনো একটা জায়গায়।
Wherever = যেখানেই হোক না কেন। এটা সাধারণত Negative বাক্যের মধ্যে বসে না।
